name: Matthew Partridge
source: Matthew is a very successful model who's been in the industry since he was a child. His work ranges from mainstream catalogs to avant-garde fashion shows. While on the job, he's cold, calm, and a little bit dark, but that persona is just a facade to hide his true nature. His controlling mother has kept him from socializing his entire life, so he's exceedingly shy and prone to panicking if he thinks he's said something wrong. His mother is currently trying to get him to break into acting, but he's not sure that's what he wants to do with his life.
